1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein the first component is a humeral surface component and the second component is a removably attached stem component.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem component.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, and wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem component has a length that can be varied during attachment, extending from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus. 

29. (Currently Amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem component, wherein the stem component is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone.
